description_en: Clones an experiment group to a specified environment
description_zh: 向指定环境克隆一个实验组
kebab_example: aliyun pairecservice clone-experiment-group --experiment-group-id 3 --instance-id pairec-cn-abcdefg1234 --layer-id 3 --environment Daily --region cn-hangzhou
name: CloneExperimentGroup

parameters.help_en: The experiment group ID. You can get this ID by calling the ListExperimentGroups operation
parameters.help_zh: 实验组ID，可通过接口ListExperimentGroups获取
parameters.name: experiment_group_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can get this ID by calling the ListInstances operation
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The layer ID. You can get this ID by calling the ListLayers operation
parameters.name: layer_id

parameters.help_en: The target environment for the experiment group. ● Daily: Daily environment ● Pre: pre-release environment ● Prod: production environment
parameters.help_zh:
克隆到的环境。
● Daily-日常环境
● Pre-预发环境
● Prod-生产环境
parameters.name: environment
